purpose: Pinned source-of-truth ownership map for the controlled NovaForge 2.0 rewrite. Preserve proven truth boundaries; replace legacy presentation gravity wells behind staged seams.

destinationModules.responsibility: Composition, navigation, lifecycle handoff, system presentation only.
My Apps/project library and project selection semantics.
Durable mission lifecycle, stages, steering, checkpoints, and user-facing mission state.
Model-agnostic agent orchestration contracts and mission execution semantics.
Approval, risk, mutation authority, replay protection, and policy receipts.
Typed bounded tool contracts and execution adapters.
Provider/model route truth, hosted transport, auth binding, retries, cancellation, and streaming.
Local/cloud model metadata, compatibility, recommendations, and catalog refresh.
On-device inference execution, loading, resource preflight, and measured device behavior.
Sandboxed runnable Forge project hosting and runtime lifecycle.
Versioned permissioned host capabilities exposed to untrusted Forge projects.
Project/workspace persistence, migration, reconciliation, and durable identity.
Structured source-backed project knowledge and context virtualization.
Durable receipts, checkpoints, evidence lineage, and visual history projections.
Replayable functional/runtime acceptance and migration fixtures.
Screenshot/runtime critique, regression comparison, accessibility and polish evidence.
NovaForge visual tokens, materials, motion, haptics, accessibility behavior.
Authorized execution-environment abstraction and handoff receipts without inventing unavailable workers.

preservedFoundations.truth: Typed run/project/tool domain identities and value semantics should remain inward dependencies, not be reimplemented in views.
preservedFoundations.replacementGate: Any replacement must prove byte/semantic compatibility for durable identifiers and run lineage before old domain types are retired.

preservedFoundations.truth: Deterministic engine/reducer behavior and recovery semantics are proven foundation for long-running missions.
preservedFoundations.replacementGate: V13 mission orchestration must pass existing engine/recovery tests and prove no duplicate accepted execution across relaunch before engine contracts move.

preservedFoundations.truth: Approval and mutation authority must remain model-independent and fail closed.
preservedFoundations.replacementGate: No replacement may weaken approval binding, replay protection, risk classification, or durable mutation authority.

preservedFoundations.truth: Provider capability/route contracts belong below product UI and should survive the shell rewrite.
preservedFoundations.replacementGate: Existing provider contract tests and exact supported-route semantics pass under the new ProviderRuntime boundary.

preservedFoundations.truth: Durable run/store semantics are source truth; presentation projections are not.
preservedFoundations.replacementGate: Migration and relaunch fixtures preserve accepted record identity, lineage, terminal state, and receipts.

preservedFoundations.truth: Typed tool authority and bounded tool semantics must remain independent from generated/model output.
preservedFoundations.replacementGate: All mutation/read tool conformance and policy integration tests pass after any extraction.

preservedFoundations.truth: Transport framing/stream semantics are reusable lower-layer behavior.
preservedFoundations.replacementGate: Streaming, cancellation, retry, and error mapping remain contract-compatible for every SUPPORTED route.

preservedFoundations.truth: Hosted route serialization/stream parsing/provider gateway behavior is product-critical but should not stay coupled to app presentation.
preservedFoundations.replacementGate: Exact provider-route matrix, error classes, structured output/tool behavior, cancellation, and streaming tests pass after extraction.

preservedFoundations.truth: Working SwiftLlama/llama.cpp inference, device-fit checks, model download/validation behavior are flagship foundation, while catalog metadata should become independently updatable.
preservedFoundations.replacementGate: Physical-device local inference evidence, model integrity validation, memory/resource preflight, and local-only no-cloud-fallback behavior remain truthful.

preservedFoundations.truth: Provider secrets already live behind a this-device-only Keychain boundary and must not leak into Project Brain/history/migration JSON.
preservedFoundations.replacementGate: Replacement reads existing Keychain accounts in place or explicitly re-authenticates; no plaintext secret migration/export exists.

preservedFoundations.truth: Approval UI HMAC authority is a separate device-bound secret from provider credentials; simulator fallback is test authority only.
preservedFoundations.replacementGate: Physical-device authority remains in the existing Data Protection Keychain account and cannot be silently regenerated or exported.

preservedFoundations.truth: Content-addressed before-state checkpoints and protected policy paths provide rollback and recovery truth.
preservedFoundations.replacementGate: Interrupted mutation recovery remains idempotent and bound to workspace/revision/effect/payload/before-state identity.

preservedFoundations.truth: Accepted run ownership is durable continuation evidence separate from SwiftData presentation records.
preservedFoundations.replacementGate: Mission handoff/relaunch cannot duplicate an accepted run or accept stale conflicting ownership.

preservedFoundations.truth: Legacy SwiftData classification, compatibility fallback, quarantine, reconciliation, and launch repair are proven migration behavior embedded in app composition.
preservedFoundations.replacementGate: ProjectStore owns equivalent versioned migration/recovery tests before persistence logic is removed from app launch composition.

prohibitedInheritance: FlatToolArgumentParser scalar-string bridge as V13 tool contract
chat transcript as durable mission database
UI observation state as execution authority
transitionalAdapters.replacementGate: ForgeMission can execute/resume a mission through typed AgentHarnessKit/provider/tool interfaces without AppRootView or ChatView owning execution state.

prohibitedInheritance: new feature business logic in the app entry point
migration authority duplicated across feature modules
transitionalAdapters.replacementGate: AppShell becomes thin composition while ProjectStore owns persistence/migration and security/runtime owners remain separate.

legacyHotspots.why: The root currently owns tabs, launch lifecycle, multiple runtimes, approval presentation, project/conversation selection, persistence work, and extensive debug state.
legacyHotspots.replacementGate: New AppShell routes complete core flows while durable execution/persistence/security state is owned below the view tree; legacy root remains a rollback path until runtime/UI acceptance passes.

legacyHotspots.why: V13 Forge/Plan Space/Forge Pulse is mission-first; legacy chat surfaces conflate transcript, progress, composer controls, and run presentation.
legacyHotspots.replacementGate: Intent -> material questions -> Ready to Forge -> live mission -> Run handoff works end-to-end with accessibility and interruption/resume evidence before old chat surfaces are retired.

legacyHotspots.why: Runnable artifact behavior is currently concentrated in a sheet-shaped legacy presentation rather than a first-class sandboxed Run product.
legacyHotspots.replacementGate: Supported Forge projects launch full-screen through a sandboxed runtime with controlled bridges, safe return, errors, orientation, storage, and runtime evidence.

legacyHotspots.why: Files/code remain valuable expert surfaces, but repository-browser presentation must not own project identity or Project Brain truth.
legacyHotspots.replacementGate: New Edit/Inspect can browse/search/edit large projects through stable ProjectStore/ProjectBrain contracts without losing source identity or mutation safety.

legacyHotspots.why: V13 My Apps must present runnable creations rather than repository/dashboard machinery.
legacyHotspots.replacementGate: Real project cards, active mission continuation, runnable previews, duplicate/remix/export routing, and durable project identity are proven before dashboard removal.

legacyHotspots.why: History should project durable mission/checkpoint/evidence truth, not remain a legacy run-card information architecture.
legacyHotspots.replacementGate: History can render exact receipts, checkpoints, evidence levels, before/after state, restore/fork/compare from durable sources after relaunch.

legacyHotspots.why: Provider/security truth is worth preserving, but V13 Control and flagship Model Center require a new capability-first surface.
legacyHotspots.replacementGate: Local/cloud selection, device compatibility, downloads, privacy/local-only, provider auth, and advanced controls all project truthful underlying state before legacy settings UI removal.

legacyHotspots.why: Terminal is optional Pro capability, not a core product identity; useful interaction behaviors can be retained without making terminal navigation architectural.
legacyHotspots.replacementGate: Expert command access remains available where authorized after core product surfaces no longer depend on a terminal tab.

legacyHotspots.why: Existing reusable controls may contain useful interaction/accessibility work, but V13 requires a deliberate NovaForge Glass hierarchy rather than preserving a legacy control catalogue wholesale.
legacyHotspots.replacementGate: DesignSystem fixtures cover Reduce Transparency, Reduce Motion, Dynamic Type, contrast, 44pt targets, and the new material hierarchy before old controls are removed.

replacementSeams.gate: Accept the durable-data contract and this ownership map before broad source deletion or state relocation.
Wrap current SwiftData/workspace/compatibility/recovery truth behind one tested owner without changing authoritative bytes prematurely.
Allow V13 feature surfaces to enter through a thin shell while legacy root remains an explicit compatibility route during staged replacement.
Run/resume missions using durable AgentHarnessKit/receipt state rather than treating transcript or legacy view state as mission identity.
Extract runnable project hosting from legacy artifact presentation into a sandboxed full-screen runtime with explicit host permissions.
Switch My Apps/History/Control projections only after parity, migration, accessibility, performance, and visual acceptance evidence.
Delete legacy owners only after replacement tests pass on exact head and no durable user/security/execution truth is stranded.

dependencyRules: New V13 product modules may depend on AgentHarnessKit modules or explicit typed adapters; they must not import AgentPad/Views as a source-of-truth dependency.
AppShell is composition and navigation only; provider, tool, policy, persistence, migration, and mission business logic belong below it.
ProjectStore is the sole V13 owner of project/workspace persistence and migration/reconciliation; SwiftUI views may query projections but do not own store repair.
ForgeMission durable mission identity/state is independent of chat transcript and legacy AgentRuntime observation state.
AgentPolicy remains the authority for approval/mutation capability; model output or migrated UI state can never grant itself authority.
RuntimeBridge exposes explicit versioned safe host capabilities; ForgeRuntime projects cannot directly reach provider credentials, approval-signing secrets, or arbitrary native/system authority.
ProjectHistory projects durable receipts/checkpoints/evidence and does not become an execution engine.
DesignSystem has no feature/domain dependencies; feature modules consume it, never the reverse.
CloudContinuation and MacWorker modules are not introduced as ordinary product dependencies until real authorized execution substrates exist.
A legacy hotspot is retired only after its replacementGate and the durable-data deletion gates are proven on an exact accepted head.
